articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Vision, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process code repositories, visual diagrams, and spoken instructions in a single inference pass. Benchmarks show a 34% improvement on SWE-Bench over GPT-5 base, with significantly reduced hallucination rates on complex multi-step engineering tasks. The model is available via API with a new structured-output guarantee mode aimed at production agentic workflows.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Mathematical Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2 solved 89% of International Mathematical Olympiad 2026 problems at a gold-medal level, a marked jump from last year's performance. The system combines advanced chain-of-thought search with a learned formal verification step that checks proof validity before outputting solutions. Researchers say the architecture's self-verification loop has broad implications for reliable reasoning in safety-critical AI applications.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Deploys Humanoid Workers at BMW's Spartanburg Plant at Scale
articles.summary: Figure announced that over 200 of its Figure 03 humanoid robots are now operating across multiple production lines at BMW's South Carolina manufacturing facility, handling bin-picking, parts transfer, and quality inspection tasks. The deployment marks the largest commercial humanoid workforce in automotive manufacturing to date. BMW reports a 17% throughput improvement in augmented lines with a target of 500 units deployed by early 2027.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Demonstrates Autonomous Household Task Completion in Public Demo
articles.summary: Tesla showcased its Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robot completing a sequence of unsupervised household tasks including laundry folding, dish loading, and navigating cluttered rooms at an invite-only event in Palo Alto. The robot uses an end-to-end vision-language-action model trained on both simulation and real-world teleoperation data. Musk indicated limited consumer availability could begin in late 2027, with factory deployment at Tesla's Gigafactories accelerating this quarter.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces 'Claude Constitution 2.0' Framework for Enterprise AI Governance
articles.summary: Anthropic published its updated Constitutional AI governance framework designed for enterprise deployment, featuring granular policy layers that let organizations define domain-specific safety constraints, audit trails, and compliance rules declaratively. The system integrates with Claude's reasoning trace to provide explainable enforcement decisions for regulated industries. Early adopters in financial services and healthcare report significantly reduced review overhead for AI-assisted decision-making.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed that its N1.4 process node has entered volume production at its Fab 20 facility in Hsinchu, roughly one quarter ahead of the original roadmap. The node delivers a 20% power efficiency gain over N2 with gate-all-around nanosheet transistors and backside power delivery. Apple, Nvidia, and Qualcomm are reportedly among the first customers, with chips expected in consumer devices by mid-2027.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Approval for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface Implant
articles.summary: The FDA granted approval for Neuralink's N2 implant, a second-generation brain-computer interface with 4,096 electrodes and wireless charging, for expanded clinical trials in patients with quadriplegia and ALS. Early trial data from the first-generation device showed participants achieving cursor control speeds approaching able-bodied benchmarks. The N2 doubles channel count and adds bidirectional stimulation capability, opening pathways toward sensory feedback applications.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Platform for Construction Site Autonomy
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics officially launched the commercial Atlas platform purpose-built for construction environments, featuring reinforced IP67 housing, 20-hour battery life, and integration APIs for BIM software. The electric humanoid can autonomously navigate unfinished building sites, transport materials up stairs, and perform basic inspection routines using onboard lidar and thermal imaging. Three major construction firms have signed pilot contracts for deployment on active jobsites starting Q4 2026.
